definitions.explanation: An expression of dissatisfaction about something, often made formally.

examples.japanese: ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧{苦情|くじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I made a complaint about the service.

examples.japanese: {苦情|くじょう}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}した→電話する：01471_denwa⟧。
examples.english: I called the complaints handling desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦情|くじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{隣人|りんじん}→隣人：noentry⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A noise complaint came from a neighbor.

notes:
{苦情|くじょう} is used for complaints, especially in formal or customer service contexts.

Common collocations:
- {苦情|くじょう}を{言|い}う/{申|もう}し{立|た}てる (to make a complaint)
- {苦情|くじょう}を{受|う}ける (to receive a complaint)
- {苦情|くじょう}{処理|しょり} (complaint handling)
- {苦情|くじょう}{窓口|まどぐち} (complaints desk/counter)
- {苦情|くじょう}が{殺到|さっとう}する (complaints flood in)

Related terms:
- クレーム (complaint - loanword, common in business)
- {不満|ふまん} (dissatisfaction)
- {文句|もんく} (complaint - more casual)
- {抗議|こうぎ} (protest)

{苦情|くじょう} is more formal than {文句|もんく}.
